shipping.question: What are your shipping options?
shipping.answer: The shipping methods, delivery times and costs available for your address are shown at checkout before you pay. You can find all the details on the "Shipping & Returns" page.

returns.question: What is your return policy?
returns.answer: You have 14 calendar days from receiving your order to withdraw from the purchase. For health and hygiene reasons, products whose seal has been opened cannot be returned under the right of withdrawal. If a product arrives faulty or damaged, we always replace or refund it. See "Shipping & Returns".

tracking.question: How can I track my order?
tracking.answer: You can check your order status (being prepared, ready, shipped or delivered) at any time from My account > Orders.

international.question: Do you offer international shipping?
international.answer: For now we only ship to addresses in Spain.
